coordinate_reference_system: WGS 84 geographic 3D (EPSG:4979); horizontal outputs use airport-local ENU meters

origin.source: FAA 28 Day NASR APT_BASE, effective 2026-10-01; ARPT_PSN_SOURCE=3RD PARTY SURVEY, POSITION_SRC_DATE=2006/05/22. Ellipsoid height is the published field elevation converted to meters plus approximate GEOID18 separation (-28.56 m).

runways.source: FAA 28 Day NASR APT_RWY and APT_RWY_END, effective 2026-10-01; RWY_LEN_SOURCE and RWY_END_PSN_SOURCE=3RD PARTY SURVEY, source date 2006/05/22.
FAA 28 Day NASR APT_RWY and APT_RWY_END, effective 2026-10-01; RWY_LEN_SOURCE and RWY_END_PSN_SOURCE=3RD PARTY SURVEY, source date 2006/05/22.

derived_anchors.definition: Runway centerline intersection calculated from the FAA runway-end line segments in local ENU.
derived_anchors.source: Computed from AUTHORITATIVE FAA NASR runway-end coordinates above.

approximation_policy.taxiway_apron_parking: APPROXIMATE: Goal 25 chart-graticule digitized features; no public surveyed centerlines, pavement polygons, or stand coordinates were obtained.

legacy_frame.description: Explicitly declared Goal 25 grid used only to migrate its chart-digitized approximate features into the new ENU frame. It is not retained as a viewer correction.

tolerance_note: The NASR coordinates are sourced from third-party surveys but FAA does not publish a horizontal accuracy estimate in these fields. 5 m is a project-level overlay tolerance, not a claim about the source survey's absolute accuracy. Numerical round-trip residuals are reported separately.
